title: Endogenous Rigidities and Capital Misallocation: Evidence from Containerships
abstract: We investigate how endogenous rigidities inhibit physical capital reallocation. We focus on the role of contract duration - a classic example of an adjustment rigidity. We argue that when agents sign longer contracts in booms when markets are thin, they generate a contracting externality which further amplifies thinness and impedes the adjustment of markets to shocks. We develop a framework with booms and busts where agents search and choose match duration. Applying the framework to the containership leasing market, we find substantial misallocation from endogenous rigidities, particularly in the transition after a crash. We also quantify implications for designing industrial policy.

title: Optimal Second-best Menu Design: Evidence from Residential Electricity Plans
venue: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: Utilities increasingly sell electricity using complex menus of time-constant and time-varying price schedules. We study how to design such a menu to maximize social welfare in a second best environment where the marginal private and external costs of generating electricity vary over time, institutional constraints prevent mandating time-varying pricing, and consumer behavior is distorted by frictions. We develop a model of plan choice, consumption, and intertemporal substitution with time-varying marginal social costs, and estimate it using administrative data from a large utility. We provide evidence of substantial intertemporal substitution in response to timevarying price incentives, and selection across plans based on multidimensional heterogeneity. While the current menu's time-varying plans substantially shift consumption from high-price to low-price hours, we find that they reduce social welfare. This loss is mitigated by information frictions. We show how to redesign the menu to simultaneously improve outcomes for consumers, the utility, and the environment.
abstract_zh: 公用事业公司越来越多地采用由时间不变和时间可变价格表组成的复杂菜单来销售电力。我们研究在次优环境下，如何设计此类菜单以使社会福利最大化：在该环境中，发电的边际私人成本和外部成本随时间变化，制度约束使得无法强制实施分时定价，且消费者行为受到摩擦的扭曲。我们建立了一个包含套餐选择、消费和跨期替代的模型，该模型具有随时间变化的边际社会成本，并利用一家大型公用事业公司的行政数据对其进行了估计。我们发现，消费者对分时价格激励存在显著的跨期替代，且基于多维异质性的套餐选择存在明显的选择效应。尽管现行菜单中的分时套餐大幅地将消费从高价时段转移到低价时段，但我们发现它们降低了社会福利。这一损失可由信息摩擦部分缓解。我们说明了如何重新设计菜单，以同时改善消费者、公用事业公司和环境的结果。

title: Technology Complementarities and Subsidy Policy: Evidence from Electric Vehicle and Solar Panel Adoption
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Optimizing Electricity Rates: Evidence from Commercial and Industrial Firms
abstract: Commercial and industrial firms account for over half of total electricity demand in many U.S. utilities, yet little is known about how they choose among electricity rate options or adjust consumption in response to prices. Although system costs vary substantially throughout the day, most firms remain on time-invariant price plans. Time-of-use (TOU) pricing introduces temporal price variation to better align demand with system costs, but its effectiveness depends on design. Using administrative data from a large U.S. utility, I document that firms switching to TOU pricing reduce peak-period demand, with significant heterogeneity across industries. I then develop and estimate a structural model of rate selection and hourly electricity consumption that incorporates operational flexibility, price responsiveness, and adjustment frictions. Identification leverages variation from switching plans. The estimated framework enables counterfactual analyses of alternative pricing menus and their implications for customer surplus, system costs, and environmental outcomes.
abstract_zh: 在许多美国公用事业公司中，商业和工业企业占总用电需求的一半以上，但人们对这些企业如何在不同电价方案中进行选择，以及如何根据价格调整用电量知之甚少。尽管系统成本在一天中变化很大，但大多数企业仍采用时间不变的电价方案。分时电价（TOU）引入了时间上的价格变化，以使需求更好地与系统成本相匹配，但其效果取决于具体设计。利用一家大型美国公用事业公司的行政数据，我们记录了切换至分时电价的企业减少了高峰时段的需求，且不同行业之间存在显著的异质性。随后，我们构建并估计了一个电价方案选择与逐时用电量的结构模型，该模型纳入了运营灵活性、价格响应性和调整摩擦。识别依托于企业切换电价方案所产生的变化。估计得到的框架使我们能够对替代性定价菜单及其对用户剩余、系统成本和环境结果的影响进行反事实分析。

title: Green Economy as a Labor Productivity Factor in the Manufacturing Industry of European Union Countries
abstract: These days many countries declare saving natural resources and reducing anthropogenic pressure on the environment as being among their national priorities. They place importance on sustainable development and the transition to a green economy model. However, the problem of assessing the effectiveness of the green economy and the competitiveness of related technologies is still open to debate. The paper examines approaches to measuring the green economy and presents an empirical analysis of the relationship between labor productivity in the manufacturing industry and green economy factors for a number of European Union countries, characterized by high performance in the global rankings of the green economy. Studying approaches to the identification and measurement of the green economy, the authors identify trends in the realization of a new environmentally sustainable development model in the countries of the European Union and the dynamics of key indicators of the green economy. The paper develops an empirical correlation and regression model that defines, along with other factors, the influence of green economy factors on labor productivity in manufacturing. An assessment of the model specification based on panel data from the manufacturing industries of seven European countries shows a significant positive effect of investment in equipment and plant for pollution control on labor productivity in the industry. The results indicate the relevance of further studies, in particular, the possible attractiveness of private investment in the formation of a green economy in various sectors of the economy in both developed and developing countries.
abstract_zh: 如今，许多国家宣布节约自然资源和减轻人为环境压力是其国家优先事项。它们重视可持续发展以及向绿色经济模式的转型。然而，评估绿色经济的有效性以及相关技术的竞争力，仍然是有争议的问题。本文考察了衡量绿色经济的方法，并对一些在全球绿色经济排名中表现突出的欧盟国家，制造业劳动生产率与绿色经济因素之间的关系进行了实证分析。在研究绿色经济的识别和衡量方法的基础上，作者识别了欧盟国家实现新的环境可持续发展模式的趋势，以及关键绿色经济指标的动态变化。本文构建了一个实证相关和回归模型，该模型在其他因素之外，界定了绿色经济因素对制造业劳动生产率的影响。基于七个欧洲国家制造业的面板数据对模型设定进行的评估表明，用于污染控制的设备和厂房投资对行业劳动生产率具有显著的正向效应。研究结果表明，有必要进一步开展研究，特别是私人投资在发达国家和发展中国家各经济部门形成绿色经济过程中可能具有的吸引力。
